segments.name: Semiconductors
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells certified secure microprocessors and certificates for chip makers, device manufacturers and IoT customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Semiconductors segment encompasses the design, manufacturing, sales and distribution of high-end, Common Criteria EAL5+ & FIPS 140-3-certified secure microprocessors.

segments.name: ASIC
segments.description: Provides custom ASIC and System on Chip development and production services for customers needing dedicated silicon, from specification through qualification and supply chain.
segments.evidence: The ASIC segment's operations include a complete offering for Application Specific Integrated Circuits (ASIC) and Systems on Chip (SoC) development from circuit specification, mastering design in-house, up to qualification and the management of the entire production supply chain.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for secure chips and for certificates, SaaS, software licenses and customer support used in cybersecurity applications.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group generates revenues from the sale of semiconductors secure chips and from Digital Certificates, Software as a Service, Software license and Post-Contract Customer Support (PCS) for cybersecurity applications.

changes.text: In 2025 the company revised its reportable segments, so it now reports two segments: Semiconductors and ASIC.
changes.evidence: In 2025, the SEALSQ Group revised its reportable segments to reflect changes in internal management reporting.

changes.text: The ASIC segment was added in 2025 following the acquisition of IC'Alps.
changes.evidence: The ASIC reportable segment did not exist in SEALSQ's financials prior to August 4, 2025, the date SEALSQ acquired IC'Alps.
